messages:
leah: Idea: add a 'preview simulator' to the console so owners can see estimated latency/cost/affected tenants before applying a flag change. It should run a short traffic replay against the new config and emit a scoreboard. Thoughts?
rafael: Nice. How do we get representative traffic? Full replay is expensive. Maybe sample recent traffic + weight by endpoint?
kim: We can do a two-mode approach: 1) "quick-sim" using sampled traces (1k requests) for cheap estimate, 2) "fidelity-sim" that replays a window (e.g., 30m) in a sandbox and hits real runtime paths. Quick-sim fast, fidelity-sim slower but more accurate.
leah: Exactly. Quick-sim gives a cost/lantency delta and a confidence band. Fidelity-run runs in a dry-run route that returns simulated responses but still exercises kernels/quantization and routing.
telemetry-bot: metric-sampler: existing traces available for 90 days. Could add an API to pull by tenant + route.
rafael: We should be careful about side-effects (external calls, downstream state). Fidelity-sim must stub any side-effecting ops.
kim: Agreed. We'll run fidelity-sim in a hardened sandbox with mocked downstreams and enable only inference compute. Also support model-substitution to validate alternate fallback routing.
leah: UX ask: show a compact scoreboard with tokens, p50/p95 latency delta, cost delta, and a histogram of affected tenant percentiles. Also a "risk" score that combines volume sensitivity + previous rollout flakiness.
ux: I can mock the card. Include an "apply dry-run" toggle that creates a shadow route for 1% traffic for N minutes and surfaces real telemetry to the same card. That bridges sim vs real.
rafael: Implementation notes: need an idempotent preview API: POST /v1/configs/preview -> preview_id. Internally we build a simulation plan referencing traces and runtime model variants. Preview results stored in telemetry ledger for 7 days.
devops-bot: env-check: sandbox accounts provisioned on staging for fidelity-sim. Need quota tickets if we run fidelity-sim often.
leah: Cost-estimates: use per-token unit costs + GPU-ms from runtime logs. Add estimated error budget consumption if latency grows.
kim: For rollout safety, tie preview to rollout gates: require preview run + scoreboard "pass" (risk < threshold) for >10% rollout. Permit override with short justification. Log justification in audit.
rafael: One more: previews must respect tenant privacy. When showing sample traces, obfuscate PII and limit shown tenants unless owner has access.
leah: Good catch. I'll draft a short RFC with: API sketch, sim modes, sandbox contract, UX mock, risk scoring heuristic, and privacy rules. Who wants to review?
ux: I'll do the UX + copy.
kim: I'll review infra sandbox bits.
rafael: I'll take the preview API and telemetry ledger portion.
leah: Thanks! I'll post the RFC here when ready and attach a quick GIF of the mock. :sparkles:
